observations: Photo 0: Two black lenses lying together on bubble wrap, front lens clearly marked 'AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G', rear lens partially visible with its own focus-distance scale.
Photo 1: Same front lens held in a hand, text 'AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G' and 'Nikon' visible on the barrel.
Photo 2: Both lenses shown again with a lens hood and a lens cap in the background; rear lens markings still not fully legible.
No camera body, battery, charger, or box is visible in any photo despite the seller mentioning 'original battery and charger'.
No visible fungus, haze or scratches on the front element glass in the photos provided, but image resolution and angle limit certainty.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI - OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' overlays each image.

claims.claim: American used lens, clean and pure like new
claims.evidence: No origin marking or paperwork visible in any photo.
Item shown is a lens, not a camera body; lenses have no shutter count.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Front element in photo 0/1/2 looks clear but no close, well-lit, backlit shot of the glass is provided to rule out internal fungus or fine scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Lenses do not use batteries or chargers; no such items are shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Internal fungus or haze not visible under normal lighting
risks.proof: A photo of the lens held up against a bright light or window showing the internal elements clearly
risks.if_unproven: priced as if fungus/haze present (worst case)

risks.risk: Autofocus/aperture mechanism may not function (AF-S motor, aperture blades)
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the lens mounted on a camera, autofocus racking and aperture stopping down

risks.risk: Mount or electronic contacts could be damaged or corroded
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear mount and electronic contacts
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case (possible mount damage)

risks.risk: Two different lenses appear in the photos - unclear which exact lens is being sold
risks.proof: A single clear photo of only the lens being sold, with its full nameplate in focus

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (battery, charger) are irrelevant/mismatched to a lens, suggesting a copy-pasted or inaccurate listing
risks.proof: Photo of actual included accessories (lens cap, hood, pouch, box) matching the lens
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare lens only, no extra accessories

proof_requests: Video of the lens mounted on a Nikon body showing autofocus and aperture operation
Close-up photo of the rear mount and contacts
Backlit photo of the front and rear glass elements for fungus/scratch check
Single clear photo confirming exactly which lens (of the two shown) is for sale
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G lens from the readable nameplate, but functional claims (AF, aperture, glass condition) are unverified and must be priced at worst case; no comparable in the list matches this exact lens, so the only matching generic 'camera lens' listing is used for both ends of the price range.
